title: Typewriter and Bridge
author: Isandro Montrose
blurb: Noor Galloway, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
